description: The humanoid walks to an object, picks it up, carries it to a drop-off station and puts it down, while a task executor and a navigation planner direct it. The monitor checks that the robot stays upright and clear of obstacles, keeps progressing towards where it is walking, completes each step within its time budget, and keeps the object in its gripper for the whole carry. The task succeeds when the object rests within half a metre of the drop-off station and is no longer held, and fails on a sustained lack of progress.

atomic_propositions.task_started: True when task_active == True. A fetch-and-deliver task has been commanded.
atomic_propositions.approaching: True when closing_speed > 0.05. The robot is getting closer to where it is walking.
atomic_propositions.stalled: True when no_progress == True. The robot has not got any closer to where it is walking for a sustained period while still away from it.
atomic_propositions.near_object: True when object_dist < 0.5. The robot is standing next to the object.
atomic_propositions.holding_object: True when holding == True. The gripper reports the object held.
atomic_propositions.near_dropoff: True when dist_to_dropoff < 0.5. The robot is at the drop-off station.
atomic_propositions.object_at_dropoff: True when object_to_dropoff < 0.5. The object is within half a metre of the drop-off station.
atomic_propositions.upright: True when upright_flag > 0.5. The robot is standing and level.
atomic_propositions.obstacle_too_close: True when min_range < 0.3. An obstacle is dangerously close to the robot.

named_failure_modes.name: fell_over
named_failure_modes.description: The robot must never fall; a fall stops the task at once.

named_failure_modes.name: collision_imminent
named_failure_modes.description: The robot must never come dangerously close to an obstacle.

execution_phases.description: The robot walks to the object, getting steadily closer to it.
Standing next to the object, the robot picks it up.
The robot carries the object to the drop-off station, keeping it in its gripper and getting steadily closer.
execution_phases.invariant: upright and holding_object and not obstacle_too_close

execution_phases.description: At the drop-off station, the robot puts the object down.

terminal_success.condition: object_at_dropoff and not holding_object and upright
terminal_success.description: The object rests within half a metre of the drop-off station, the robot no longer holds it, and the robot is upright.

terminal_failure.description: The robot has not got any closer to where it is walking for a sustained period while still away from it.
